description: Implementation of the rx::Image11 class, which manages Direct3D 11 texture resources, staging textures, and related operations such as mipmap generation, copying, loading data, and resource recovery within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Image11
classes.description: Manages Direct3D 11 texture resources, staging textures, and related operations such as mipmap generation, copying, loading data, and resource recovery within ANGLE.

methods.name: GenerateMipmap
methods.description: Generates mipmaps for a texture by copying and processing pixel data from source to destination.

methods.name: CopyImage
methods.description: Copies image data from a source to a destination texture, with optional flipping and alpha premultiplication.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the image has been modified and needs to be re-uploaded or processed.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies image data into a TextureStorage object, managing staging textures and storage association.

methods.name: verifyAssociatedStorageValid
methods.description: Verifies that the associated storage object is valid.

methods.name: recoverFromAssociatedStorage
methods.description: Recovers image data from associated TextureStorage if needed.

methods.name: disassociateStorage
methods.description: Disassociates the image from its current TextureStorage.

methods.name: redefine
methods.description: Redefines the image's format, size, and type, resetting storage associations.

methods.name: getDXGIFormat
methods.description: Returns the DXGI format of the texture.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads pixel data into the texture from client memory.

methods.name: loadCompressedData
methods.description: Loads compressed pixel data into the texture.

methods.name: copyFromTexStorage
methods.description: Copies data from a TextureStorage object into the image.

methods.name: copyFromFramebuffer
methods.description: Copies data from a framebuffer attachment into the image, with format conversion if necessary.

methods.name: copyWithoutConversion
methods.description: Performs a direct copy of texture data without format conversion.

methods.name: getStagingTexture
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the staging texture used for data transfer.

methods.name: createStagingTexture
methods.description: Creates a staging texture based on current image parameters.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the staging texture for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the staging texture after CPU access.
